Description:
[b][color=#e69138]* 介绍 *[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]*introduce *[/color][/b]

[color=#e69138]狮子保镖已就位，为您的家庭保驾护航！[/color]
Lion bodyguards are in place to protect your family！

[color=#e69138]这是一组季节性的中式石狮子雕像mod，它替换了法师家具目录中的卷叶树。[/color]
This is a seasonal Chinese stone lion statue mod that replaces the curly tree in the Wizard's furniture catalog.

[color=#e69138]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.


————————————————————————————————————
[b][color=#6aa84f]* 使用方式 *[/color]
* How to use *[/b]

[color=#6aa84f]确保下载了[b] SMAPI [/b]和 [b]Alternative Textures[/b]。[/color]
Make sure to download [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Alternative Textures[/b].

[color=#6aa84f]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.

[color=#6aa84f]进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买油漆桶，左键对家具使用即可。[/color]
After entering the game, find Robin the carpenter to buy a paint bucket, left click on the furniture to use.
